findings.observation: Reviewed Sheet 6 (Austin Water General Information) which contains an 'AULCC REQUIREMENT' section (Block 3). This section asks 'DOES THIS PROJECT REQUIRE AULCC REVIEW? (>300 LF OF W/WW PIPING IN ROW)' and the 'YES' checkbox is marked. The form states 'IF YES, PLEASE PROVIDE UCC#' followed by '(pending)'. Also reviewed Sheet 6 Block 11 which shows 44 LF of 12' water main and 79 LF + 21 LF = 100 LF of water services. The site is not in DAPCZ (facts.md confirms location in South Austin, outside the DAPCZ boundaries). The project acknowledges AULCC review is required due to >300 LF of water/wastewater piping in ROW, but the UCC# (AULCC case number) is listed as pending.
findings.reasoning: The checklist item requires plans to be submitted or referenced for AULCC when excavations exceed 300 LF outside DAPCZ (or 25 LF in DAPCZ). The site is outside DAPCZ, so the 300 LF threshold applies. Sheet 6 explicitly acknowledges that the project requires AULCC review because it has >300 LF of water/wastewater piping in ROW. However, the AULCC case number (UCC#) is listed as 'pending', indicating that while the applicant recognizes the requirement, the AULCC Completeness Letter has not been obtained and the case number is not yet provided on the plans. This is a deficiency because the checklist requires plans to be 'submitted or referenced for AULCC' when the threshold is exceeded.
findings.explanation: AULCC requirement acknowledged on Sheet 6, but UCC# is pending; no AULCC case number or Completeness Letter referenced
findings.resolution: Submit plans to AULCC for review and obtain AULCC Completeness Letter. Update Sheet 6 to include the assigned AULCC case number (UCC#) in place of 'pending'.
